about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for ade (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Both tables get the number "0" and the rest of their number is pushed into the title, so Table 0.1a and Table 0.1b cannot be told apart by number.
findings.evidence: source: "Table 0.1a" / "Table 0.1b" / tree: number "0", title ".1a Dwelling-houses..." and number "0", title ".1b Rooms..."

findings.problem: The footnote on BS 7913 is referenced in paragraph 0.7 but the tree attaches it to paragraph 0.8.
findings.evidence: source: "needs to be recognised1" (0.7) / tree: footnotes "1 BS 7913 The principles of the conservation of historic buildings" under para-0.8

findings.problem: The numbered list items 1 to 4 of paragraph 1.41 are run into the intro sentence instead of kept as separate list items; the words are all there.
findings.evidence: tree: "in the order below: 1. Address of building. 2. Type(s) of property. ... 3. Date(s) of testing. 4. Organisation carrying out testing, including:"

findings.problem: The subscript Xmm on the dynamic stiffness k is dropped in paragraph 2.19, so k is no longer tied to the cavity width.
findings.evidence: source: "dynamic stiffness, kXmm in MN/m ... is n.kXmm<4.8MN/m³" / tree: "dynamic stiffness, k in MN/m ... is n.k <4.8MN/m³"

findings.problem: The dropped subscripts appear as two stray text blocks holding only "Xmm", with a repeated heading as title.
findings.evidence: tree: section-2-walls-ties-in-separating-and-box-1 text "Xmm"; box-2 text "Xmm"

findings.problem: The bold condition sentence for wall type 2.3 is split into two headings, so paragraph 2.71 sits under a heading reading only "stagger of at least 300mm." and the rule is broken apart.
findings.evidence: source: "Additional construction: wall type 2.3 should only be used where there is a step and/or stagger of at least 300mm." / tree: two headings "...step and/or" and "stagger of at least 300mm."

findings.problem: Paragraph 2.70 is placed under the heading of the example box for wall type 2.1 instead of directly under Wall type 2.
findings.evidence: tree: "Wall type 2: cavity masonry > Example of wall type 2.1 > Paragraph 2.70"

findings.problem: The note after the Example of wall type 2.3 box is printed outside the box but the tree puts it inside the example text.
findings.evidence: source: "Note: Increasing the size of the step or stagger in the separating wall tends to increase the airborne sound insulation." (below box) / tree: inside example-of-wall-type-2-3-text-1

findings.problem: Diagram 2.16 (wall type 2.2) is placed under the heading Example of wall type 2.3.
findings.evidence: tree: "Example of wall type 2.3 > Wall type 2.2"

findings.problem: Diagrams 2.20 and 2.22 (external cavity wall junctions) are placed under the heading 'Junctions with internal masonry walls' instead of the external wall junction headings they belong to.
findings.evidence: tree: "Junctions with internal masonry walls > Wall type 2 – external cavity wall with timber frame inner leaf"

findings.problem: Diagrams 2.31 and 2.32 are placed under 'Junctions with internal timber floors' although they illustrate external cavity wall and internal framed wall junctions.
findings.evidence: tree: "Junctions with internal timber floors > Wall type 3 – external cavity wall with masonry inner leaf"

findings.problem: Diagram 3.23 (floor type 3 with wall type 2) is placed under the heading for separating wall type 4 instead of wall type 2.
findings.evidence: tree: "Junctions with a separating wall type 4 – timber frames with absorbent material > Floor type 3 – wall type 2"

findings.problem: The last word of the Table 7.1 caption was split off into a separate heading 'buildings', truncating the table title.
findings.evidence: source: "Absorption coefficient data for common materials in buildings" / tree: "Absorption coefficient data for common materials in" + heading "buildings"

findings.problem: The whole Table 7.1 is repeated as a running text block after the table under the spurious 'buildings' heading.
findings.evidence: tree: "Material Sound absorption coefficient, α in octave frequency bands (Hz) 250 500 1000 2000 4000 Fair-faced concrete 0.01..."

findings.problem: The subscript 'ceiling' of α in paragraph 7.24 was cut out into a separate text block.
findings.evidence: source: "coefficient, αceiling, needed" / tree: "coefficient, α , needed" + text "ceiling"

findings.problem: The column group heading 'Sound absorption coefficient, α in octave frequency bands' is missing from the grid column names.
findings.evidence: source: "Sound absorption coefficient, α in octave frequency bands (Hz)" / tree: "250 Hz"

findings.problem: The subscript T of A_T is split onto its own line in the step text, so the formula reads 'A – total absorption area'.
findings.evidence: source: "Additional absorption = AT – total absorption area" / tree: "(Additional absorption = A – total absorption area (from Step 5)). T"

findings.problem: The A2.1 formula and the 'where' list defining each symbol are not in the tree.
findings.evidence: source: "= MB + ρm (Td (L + H – d) + V) / LH kg/m2 ... MB is brick/block mass (kg) at appropriate moisture content"

findings.problem: Table A.1 is kept as a text box titled 'A3 Simplified equations' instead of a table titled Table A.1, with its block mass / mass per unit area rows as running lines.
findings.evidence: tree: "title: A3 Simplified equations ... Block mass, MB (kg) Mass per unit area (kg/m2) 6 164"

findings.problem: Subscripts split off or mangled: 'MB' becomes 'M ... B' and 'ρm' becomes 'rm'.
findings.evidence: source: "Substituting for MB in this formula" / tree: "Substituting for M in this formula gives the following values: B"; source: "ρm = 1800kg/m3" / tree: "rm = 1800kg/m3"

findings.problem: The Diagram A.1 caption is split: the first part is run into A2.4 text and 'dimensions' becomes a heading.
findings.evidence: tree: "...mass per unit area of the wall Diagram A.1 Block and mortar" + heading "dimensions"

findings.problem: Table A.2 caption appears in A3.1 text though Table A.2 is not on this page.
findings.evidence: tree: "Table A.1 Blocks laid flat Table A.2 Blocks laid on edge"

findings.problem: In B3.6 the symbol ΔLw is turned into 'DLw', a different-looking quantity.
findings.evidence: source: "performance value (ΔLw)" / tree: "performance value (DLw )"

findings.problem: In B3.13 the subscripts of the first DnT,w + Ctr are split off into a separate stray box, so the 49dB limit loses which quantity it is in.
findings.evidence: source: "at least 49dB DnT,w + Ctr" / tree: "at least 49dB D + C" and box "nT,w tr"

findings.problem: The section heading 'Noise from neighbours' is missing, so the first question sits under 'Frequently Asked Questions' instead of its own chapter.
findings.evidence: source: "Noise from neighbours" / tree: "Frequently Asked Questions > I am disturbed by noise from neighbours..."

findings.problem: The page number 4 is run into the body text where it joins the next page's text.
findings.evidence: tree: "pre-completion testing\". 4 test organisations to undertake the work."
